en: An old monochrome postcard showing a hilly landscape with scattered houses and a church standing prominently on a hilltop. In the foreground there is a circular structure or basin and some ruins with tall trees nearby. The right side of the image contains handwritten text, and printed Hungarian captions appear at the bottom and along the left edge. The reverse side is a classic divided-back postcard layout with Hungarian text, handwritten address, postmarks and a stamp.
